career_ladder.note: Recruited under the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Direct Recruitment framework for non-gazetted technical and administrative personnel. Technical Assistants (Laboratory) operate in BIS Central, Regional, and Branch Testing Laboratories handling physical, chemical, mechanical, and microbiological standards compliance testing for ISI Mark certification. Senior Secretariat Assistants (SSA) manage administrative, licensing, vigilance, and financial departments at Manak Bhavan and field directorates.

steps.designation: Senior Technical Assistant (Lab) [Level 7] / Assistant Section Officer (ASO) [Level 7]

steps.years: approx. 10-12 years (Group A officer cadre entry)
steps.source_label: BIS Service Regulations — Group A Cadre

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted in two tiers: an Online Computer Based Examination (150 objective questions, 150 marks, 120 minutes) followed by a qualifying Practical Skill / Trade Test in laboratory testing (for Technical Assistant) or Typing / Computer Proficiency Test (for SSA).

stages.source_label: BIS Advertisement No. 02/2022/ESTT & Advt 01/2024/ESTT — Scheme of Examination

financial_package.pay_source_label: BIS Notification — 7th CPC Level 6 (₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400) for Technical Assistant (Lab)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400. Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹20,532. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹3,540 (10% in Z-class cities) to ₹10,620 (30% in X-class cities like New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai). Transport Allowance is ₹5,688 (higher TPTA) or ₹2,844 (other). Deductions include NPS 10% (Basic + DA = ₹5,593), medical contribution, and professional tax.
official_perks: Residential accommodation in BIS Staff Quarters across regional capitals (or HRA)
Comprehensive medical treatment and reimbursement under BIS Medical Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual leave encashment per central rules
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and hostel subsidy
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% employer contribution
Performance incentives and lab technical allowances
